title: La Piñata de Acolman, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: pinata-acolman (MAJESTIC): patio de un taller de piñatas en Acolman, Estado de México, en Nochebuena. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.PASCUAL_ROJAS: Mexican man from the State of Mexico, piñata maker, 76 years old, small and thin, brown wrinkled skin, white hair, round glasses, a white mustache, a beige knitted cardigan over a plaid shirt, grey trousers, his hands empty.
chars.EMILIO_ROJAS: Mexican man, 45 years old, light-brown skin, short black hair with a receding hairline, clean-shaven, a navy-blue quilted vest over a light-blue shirt, khaki trousers, his hands empty.
chars.YESENIA_PINEDA: Mexican woman, 42 years old, light skin, straight dyed burgundy hair, heavy makeup, a red Christmas sweater with white snowflakes, black leggings, ankle boots, holding a folder of papers.
chars.EUGENIA_SALAS: Mexican notary, 60 years old, elegant, light-brown skin, short grey hair, gold-rimmed glasses, a camel wool coat over a black turtleneck, a red scarf, pearl earrings, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_PATIOPINATAS: Patio of a family piñata workshop in Acolman, State of Mexico, on Christmas Eve night: many colorful seven-pointed star piñatas hanging from strings, warm string lights and paper lanterns, a long wooden table with paper, glue pots and clay pots, an adobe house with a wooden door, a small nativity scene in a corner, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
